'''Marilyn Janet Breen''' (born 1944)<ref>Birth year from [http://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/n82004028.html Library of Congress catalog entry], retrieved 2018-12-01.</ref> is a professor of mathematics at the [[University of Oklahoma]].<ref name="uof">[http://catalog.ou.edu/current/Faculty.htm Univ. of Oklahoma faculty listing], retrieved 2014-12-21.</ref> Her research involves geometry, including [[Visibility polygon|visibility]] and [[orthogonal polygon]]s.

==Life and work==
Breen graduated in 1966 from [[Agnes Scott College]],<ref name="uof"/> and received her Ph.D. from [[Clemson University]] in 1970 under the supervision of William Ray Hare Jr.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=14928|title=Marilyn Breen}}</ref> She joined the Oklahoma faculty in 1971 and was promoted to full professor in 1982.<ref name="uof"/>

==Awards and honors==
In her time at the University of Oklahoma, Breen won several awards for teaching and research, including an "outstanding teacher" award.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.math.ou.edu/people/emeriti/|title=Retired Faculty of the OU Math Department|accessdate=Feb 1, 2015|archive-date=February 17, 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150217042109/http://www.math.ou.edu/people/emeriti/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

In 2012, Breen became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list |title=List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society |access-date=2014-12-21 |archive-date=2018-08-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180825194636/http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list |url-status=dead }}</ref>
